```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(here)
library(SuperCell)
library(mclust)
library(grid)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(tibble)

```


## Import SuperCells

```{r}

sc_files <- list.files(
  path = here(),
  pattern = "_scObject\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

sc_files

scs <- lapply(sc_files, readRDS)
feature_list <- lapply(scs, rownames)

shared.features <- Reduce(f = intersect, x = feature_list)

scs_shared_only <- lapply(scs, function(obj) {
  return(obj[shared.features, ])
})

scs_merged <- merge(x = scs_shared_only[[1]], y = scs_shared_only[-1])

rm(scs)
rm(scs_shared_only)

```

```{r}

scs_merged <- NormalizeData(scs_merged) |> FindVariableFeatures() |> ScaleData() |> RunPCA()
scs_merged <- RunHarmony(
  scs_merged,
  group.by.vars = c("dataset", "pt_id"),
  theta = c(5, 2),
  max_iter = 20
)

ndim <- 30
  
scs_merged <- FindNeighbors(
    scs_merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim
)
  
scs_merged <- FindClusters(
    scs_merged,
    resolution = 0.25,
    random.seed = 20200204
)
  
scs_merged <- RunUMAP(
    scs_merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim,
    seed.use = 20200204
  )

# subpop_colors <- c(
#   "SHH-A1" = "red",
#   "SHH-A2" = "orange",
#   "SHH-B1" = "gold",
#   "SHH-B2" = "green",
#   "SHH-C1" = "skyblue",
#   "SHH-C2" = "violet"
# )

combinedDimPlot <- DimPlot(
    scs_merged,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.25"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Ghasemi + Riemondy: SC + Harmony by Cluster") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5)))

combined_byPatient <- DimPlot(
  scs_merged,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "dataset"
) +
  labs(title = "Ghasemi + Riemondy: SC + Harmony by Patient")
  
ggsave(file.path(here(),
                 "Integration", 
                 "results",
                 "sc_combined_Dim_Plot.png"),
       plot = combinedDimPlot,
       width = 12,
       height = 10,
       bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(here(),
                 "Integration",
                 "results",
                 "sc_combined_Dim_Plot_byPatient.png"),
       plot = combined_byPatient,
       width = 12,
       height = 10,
       bg = "white")


```
